name: GPMoto Challenge
summary:
GPMoto Challenge is a game developed and published by LOSEDEAD, with its release date for PC on June 17, 2022.
The game is described as a pulse-pounding, arcade-style racer that features a simulation feel, allowing players to drive powerful cars on famous tracks from around the world, with options for day and night-time races, varying weather conditions, and unique car handling.
It supports various game modes including single-player, online multiplayer, co-op, PvP, and local multiplayer, and includes full controller support.
The game is available on PC and has been featured on platforms like Steam, although it is currently not listed on Steam's storefront.
